answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of unique personhood serves as an economic inlet to prevent overwhelming Sybil attacks. Each agent must stake native tokens to register, binding its virtual operational weight to a physical or verifiable human identity analog—functioning much like a rigid willow anchoring against a flood. To further mirror real-world trust dynamics, the network slashes collateral if correlated outputs are detected, imposing a severe financial cost on any attacker attempting to spawn fake identities.
